limits: jrc-tiles: No duplicate rasters are included in this erratum. The current retrieval is exact-byte verified against the earlier stored files; complete corrected monthly pixel counts remain unexecuted because the full decoded phase exceeds the complete-operation cap.
jrc-access: A page capture establishes what the official site said at capture time, not future terms or full scientific fitness.
jrc-guide: Official guide values are interpreted as monthly observations; they do not classify whole components.
atlas-scope: Atlas parent and source-contact lineage is identity/hierarchy context, not independent adjudication of territorial entitlement or the physical component boundary.
geoboundaries-esp: The simplified administrative product is contextual source granularity and does not prove effective boundary date or physical component ownership.
geoboundaries-prt: The simplified administrative product is contextual source granularity and does not prove effective boundary date or physical component ownership.
mapa-current: Joins do not restore the missing historical Atlas source bytes or prove historical boundaries.
apa-wfd: Planning lines are not water-surface polygons, wetted widths or a complete water/land reference.
miteco-phc: Anti-automation challenge was not bypassed; no MITECO geometry is available for analysis.
measurement: New path real remote reads using local credential; old path offline replay of same metadata and exact Git blobs. Not hosted installation quota measurement.
